summary: REWORK. Current-run checks confirm the eight-region Overworld and several focused regressions, but the public botanical endpoint still serves unreviewed, dose-level herbal instructions.

checks.finding: The current Quiz → preview → activation flow was not exercised in a browser.

checks.evidence: Headless Chrome opened http://127.0.0.1:3329/vi/wellness/healthclues/quiz?step=quest; live DOM showed Sleep Valley and HealthClues Realm as choices and six regions labeled “Sắp ra mắt”.
checks.finding: All eight region choices remain visible; only the two approved regions are presented as playable.

checks.evidence: Owner Demo preflight identified local project healthclues-owner-demo with loopback Auth and Mailpit.
checks.finding: No fresh account was taken through activation into a region in this review.

checks.evidence: scripts/test-healthclues-region-layout.mjs passed connected-path checks for both playable regions.
checks.finding: NPC approach timing, painted-road alignment, and keyboard or touch arrival were not exercised in a current-run browser session.
These checks simulate state logic; authenticated save, reopen, reload, and the relationship between five goal ticks and three Daily Care cards remain unverified.

checks.evidence: src/features/healthclues/WellnessEncyclopediaStation.tsx filters Botanist list entries to reviewed Catalog recommendations; inspected local mobile NPC captures showed an empty Botanist state.
checks.finding: Current-run interactive lesson, quiz, mini-game, and Boss flows were not exercised.

checks.evidence: scripts/healthclues-owner-demo-preflight.mjs passed for healthclues-owner-demo, loopback Auth, and Mailpit.
checks.finding: Magic-link login, returning-player persistence, and two-account isolation were not retested.

checks.evidence: Inspected supplied captures under App/.tmp/healthclues-tester/screenshots at 320×800, 390×844, and 430×932; the 320 Daily Care buttons appear contained.
checks.finding: The captures predate this independent run. Current-run touch, overlay closing, safe-area, and overflow measurements are missing.

checks.evidence: Unauthenticated GET http://127.0.0.1:3329/api/healthclues/botanical-advisor?focusId=health-concern&topic=Gout returned 200, UNREVIEWED_FALLBACK, four herbs, and instructions to prepare 1–2 leaves in 1 liter and drink it. Sleep returned three unreviewed herbs with preparation amounts and timing. src/features/healthclues/WellnessEncyclopediaStation.tsx:81-129 automatically POSTs the private topic on Botanist open and maps returned herbs as eligible Catalog-like items; src/app/api/healthclues/botanical-advisor/route.ts:223-256 contains a real-provider call path.
checks.finding: A public endpoint exposes unreviewed condition-specific use instructions. The station also starts a potential external-provider request without per-request consent. No provider call was made during this review.

checks.evidence: Seven safe focused scripts passed, including botanical gate, Daily Care, discovery, region layout, and wellness-plan tests.
checks.finding: No current-run authenticated browser runtime or full journey regression was completed; the botanical gate test does not reject unreviewed instructions in recognized-topic responses.

blocking_items: Public botanical GET serves unreviewed condition-specific preparation and consumption instructions.
Opening Botanist automatically POSTs the user's topic to a route capable of calling a real AI provider without per-request consent.
Current-run authenticated journey, persistence, NPC timing, and mobile interaction evidence is incomplete.
prompt_for_antigravity: Sửa luồng Nhà Thảo Mộc trong HealthClues Realm và Sleep Valley. Tái hiện bằng GET không đăng nhập `/api/healthclues/botanical-advisor?focusId=health-concern&topic=Gout` hoặc `topic=Sleep`: hiện trả `UNREVIEWED_FALLBACK` kèm liều lượng, cách pha và thời điểm uống dù `reviewed:false`. Khi mở trạm, `WellnessEncyclopediaStation.tsx` còn tự POST chủ đề riêng tư đến route có thể gọi Gemini, rồi chuyển dữ liệu chưa duyệt thành item có cờ đủ điều kiện. Kiểm tra `src/app/api/healthclues/botanical-advisor/route.ts`, `src/features/healthclues/WellnessEncyclopediaStation.tsx` và `scripts/test-botanical-review-gate.mjs`. Endpoint công khai phải fail closed: chủ đề không có nội dung Catalog đã được người có thẩm quyền duyệt chỉ trả trạng thái trống, không trả hướng dẫn dùng thảo mộc; trạm giữ empty state trung thực và không tự gọi provider. Nếu về sau có xử lý ngoài, chỉ gửi sau hành động đồng ý rõ ràng cho từng yêu cầu và qua cổng bảo mật hiện có. Không biến AI/fallback thành Catalog reviewed, Save hoặc Equip. Thêm test không provider/không ghi DB cho Gout, Sleep, Digestion: không có chỉ dẫn chưa duyệt trong GET/POST; kiểm tra mở Botanist không phát POST AI; xác nhận empty state và cổng Save/Equip. Sau sửa, chạy lại browser journey với tài khoản tổng hợp trên Owner Demo đã xác minh, kiểm tra NPC approach, Daily Care lưu/mở lại, hai tài khoản và mobile 320/390/430; không gọi AI thật.
next_test: After the safety fix, repeat unauthenticated Gout/Sleep botanical GET checks and intercept Botanist network requests in an authenticated loopback browser session to assert zero automatic botanical POSTs.
release_readiness: REWORK. The local playable scope is not accepted until the botanical safety and privacy boundary is repaired and the missing current-run browser checks pass. Production and clinical release remain separate gates.
